top_signals.title: 10-year Treasury yield hits 5% before reversing as traders await Fed meeting
top_signals.summary: The 10-year U.S. Treasury note yield moved lower after reaching a multiyear high on Monday ahead of this week's Federal Reserve interest rate decision.
